  <style>
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Netflix+Sans:wght@300;400;500;700&display=swap');

    :root {
      --flixnet-red: #e50914;
      --flixnet-dark: #141414;
      --flixnet-gray: #808080;
    }

    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      font-family: 'Netflix Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    }

    body {
      background-color: var(--flixnet-dark);
      color: white;
    }

    .hero-gradient {
      background: linear-gradient(
        to bottom,
        rgba(20, 20, 20, 0) 0%,
        rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.15) 15%,
        rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.35) 29%,
        rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.58) 44%,
        rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.8) 68%,
        rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.97) 100%
      );
    }

    .premium-button {
      background: linear-gradient(45deg, var(--flixnet-red), #ff4b2b);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .premium-button::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -50%;
      left: -50%;
      width: 200%;
      height: 200%;
      background: linear-gradient(
        45deg,
        transparent,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1),
        transparent
      );
      transform: rotate(45deg);
      transition: 0.5s;
    }

    .premium-button:hover::after {
      transform: rotate(45deg) translate(50%, 50%);
    }

    .premium-button:hover {
      transform: scale(1.05);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.3);
    }

    .feature-card {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      transition: all 0.4s ease;
    }

    .feature-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-10px);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(229, 9, 20, 0.2);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    }

    .floating-animation {
      animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes float {
      0% { transform: translateY(0px); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-20px); }
      100% { transform: translateY(0px); }
    }

    .scroll-indicator {
      animation: bounce 2s infinite;
    }

    @keyframes bounce {
      0%, 20%, 50%, 80%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
      40% { transform: translateY(-20px); }
      60% { transform: translateY(-10px); }
    }

    .glass-nav {
      background: rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.8);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    }

    .content-fade {
      animation: contentFade 1s ease-out forwards;
    }

    @keyframes contentFade {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(20px);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }

    .premium-gradient {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--flixnet-red) 0%, #ff4b2b 100%);
    }

    .feature-icon {
      animation: pulse 2s infinite;
    }

    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { transform: scale(1); }
      50% { transform: scale(1.1); }
      100% { transform: scale(1); }
    }

    .modal {
      animation: modalFade 0.3s ease-out;
    }

    @keyframes modalFade {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(0.9);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: scale(1);
      }
    }

    .loading-spinner {
      animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
    }

    @keyframes spin {
      from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }

    ::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 8px;
    }

    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
      background: var(--flixnet-dark);
    }

    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: var(--flixnet-red);
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
      background: #ff4b2b;
    }

    /* Responsywność */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .premium-button {
        padding: 12px 20px;
        font-size: 18px;
      }
      h2 {
        font-size: 3rem;
      }
      p {
        font-size: 1.25rem;
      }
      .feature-card {
        padding: 20px;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      h2 {
        font-size: 2.5rem;
      }
      p {
        font-size: 1rem;
      }
      .premium-button {
        padding: 10px 16px;
        font-size: 16px;
      }
      .feature-card {
        padding: 15px;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      h2 {
        font-size: 2rem;
        text-align: center;
      }
      p {
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        text-align: center;
      }
      .premium-button {
        padding: 8px 12px;
        font-size: 14px;
      }
      .feature-card {
        padding: 10px;
      }
    }

    /* Responsywność obrazków */
    img {
      max-width: 100%;
      height: auto;
    }
  </style>
</head>

    const carousel = document.getElementById("carousel");

    movies.forEach((movie, index) => {
      const movieDiv = document.createElement("div");
      movieDiv.className = "movie";
      movieDiv.setAttribute("onclick", `openModal(${index})`);
      movieDiv.innerHTML = `
        <div class="movie-number">${index + 1}</div>
        <img src="${movie.image}" alt="${movie.title}">
      `;
      carousel.appendChild(movieDiv);
    });

    function openModal(index) {
      const movie = movies[index];
      document.getElementById("modalImage").src = movie.image;
      document.getElementById("modalDescription").textContent = movie.description;
      document.getElementById("modalLink").href = movie.link;
      document.getElementById("movieModal").style.display = "flex";
    }

    function closeModal() {
      document.getElementById("movieModal").style.display = "none";
    }

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>NeoVerse: Portal Przeżyć</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest"></script>
  <style>
    .modal {
      display: none;
    }
    .modal.active {
      display: flex;
    }
    @keyframes spin-slow {
      0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }
    .animate-spin-slow {
      animation: spin-slow 12s linear infinite;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body class="bg-[#0a0a0a] text-white font-sans">

  <!-- NeoVerse Portal -->
  <section class="relative z-10 py-20 px-8 bg-gradient-to-b from-black via-[#0a0a0a] to-[#0e0e2e] text-white">
    <h2 class="text-4xl font-extrabold text-center mb-16 tracking-widest text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-400 to-cyan-400">
      🌌 NeoVerse: Portal Przeżyć
    </h2>

    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-10">
      
      <!-- Świat 1 -->
      <div onclick="openExperience('CyberJazz')" class="cursor-pointer bg-[#1e1e2f] rounded-xl p-6 shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-all border border-purple-500/20 hover:border-purple-400/50 relative overflow-hidden">
        <div class="absolute -top-6 -right-6 w-32 h-32 bg-purple-600 opacity-20 rounded-full blur-2xl animate-pulse"></div>
        <h3 class="text-xl font-bold mb-2">🎷 CyberJazz</h3>
        <p class="text-gray-400">Spacer po neonowym mieście przy dźwiękach saksofonu i cyber-bitów.</p>
      </div>

      <!-- Świat 2 -->
      <div onclick="openExperience('EterUmyslu')" class="cursor-pointer bg-[#1e1e2f] rounded-xl p-6 shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-all border border-blue-500/20 hover:border-blue-400/50 relative overflow-hidden">
        <div class="absolute -bottom-6 -left-6 w-32 h-32 bg-blue-600 opacity-20 rounded-full blur-2xl animate-ping"></div>
        <h3 class="text-xl font-bold mb-2">🧠 Eter Umysłu</h3>
        <p class="text-gray-400">Przemyślenia, cytaty i dźwięki zaprojektowane do myślenia głębiej.</p>
      </div>

      <!-- Świat 3 -->
      <div onclick="openExperience('Szepty')" class="cursor-pointer bg-[#1e1e2f] rounded-xl p-6 shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-all border border-pink-500/20 hover:border-pink-400/50 relative overflow-hidden">
        <div class="absolute top-0 left-0 w-24 h-24 bg-pink-500 opacity-10 rounded-full blur-3xl animate-spin-slow"></div>
        <h3 class="text-xl font-bold mb-2">🌫️ Opowieści Szeptów</h3>
        <p class="text-gray-400">Krótka narracja, tajemnicze głosy, szum deszczu... historia dziejąca się w tle.</p>
      </div>

    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- Modal -->
  <div id="experienceModal" class="modal fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-80 hidden items-center justify-center z-50">
    <div class="bg-[#101020] text-white rounded-xl w-full max-w-2xl p-8 relative shadow-2xl">
      <button class="absolute top-4 right-4 text-gray-400 hover:text-white" onclick="closeExperience()">
        <i data-lucide="x" class="w-6 h-6"></i>
      </button>
      <h2 id="expTitle" class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4"></h2>
      <p id="expContent" class="text-gray-300 mb-6"></p>
      <audio id="expAudio" controls class="w-full rounded overflow-hidden mt-4"></audio>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Script -->
  <script>
    const experiences = {
      CyberJazz: {
        title: "CyberJazz",
        content: "Zanurz się w neonowej mgławicy miasta. Każdy dźwięk saksofonu prowadzi Cię głębiej.",
        audio: "https://www.bensound.com/bensound-music/bensound-slowmotion.mp3"
      },
      EterUmyslu: {
        title: "Eter Umysłu",
        content: "Myśli dryfują jak dym. 'Jesteś tylko świadkiem swojego umysłu.'",
        audio: "https://www.bensound.com/bensound-music/bensound-sci-fi.mp3"
      },
      Szepty: {
        title: "Opowieści Szeptów",
        content: "Głos z przeszłości. Historia, którą słyszysz tylko wtedy, gdy jest cicho.",
        audio: "https://www.bensound.com/bensound-music/bensound-slowmotion.mp3"
      }
    };

    function openExperience(key) {
      const modal = document.getElementById('experienceModal');
      const data = experiences[key];
      document.getElementById('expTitle').textContent = data.title;
      document.getElementById('expContent').textContent = data.content;
      document.getElementById('expAudio').src = data.audio;
      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
      modal.classList.add('active');
    }

    function closeExperience() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('experienceModal');
      const audio = document.getElementById('expAudio');
      audio.pause();
      modal.classList.add('hidden');
      modal.classList.remove('active');
    }

    // Załaduj ikony Lucide
    lucide.createIcons();
  </script>

</body>
</html>
